name: pk-speak
description: Desktop setup and phone gateway CLI for conversational coding agents.

scripts.build:pi-extension: npm run build && npm run build:ui && node scripts/sync-pi-extension-package.mjs
scripts.build:omp-bundle: npm run build && bun build dist/index.js --outfile dist/omp-index.js --target node --format esm
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test:parallel && npm run test:stress && npm run test:coverage
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:ui && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:parallel: npm run build && npm run build:ui && node --test --test-concurrency=4 tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && npm run build:ui && c8 --reporter=text --reporter=lcov --include='dist/**/*.js' node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:stress: npm run build && npm run build:ui && node --test tests/stress-adversarial.test.mjs
scripts.test:realtime-live: npm run build && npm run build:ui && node --experimental-test-module-mocks --test tests/integration/*.test.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run build:ui
